name: Cobb County 2024–25 Georgia Milestones EOG district comparison
model_scope: Cobb County independent 2024–25 grade-school models use exact NCES LEA 1301290 / native GA-633 identities. All 90 operational pure lower offered and reconciled enrolled grade profiles remain searchable, with separate fixed 90-school Math, ELA and Combined models. Outcomes use original regular Georgia Milestones EOG All Students G38 Levels 3–4 published rates; income uses each school’s own reported individual direct certification divided by reported same-year membership. Primary-only, high and mixed configurations remain outside. Income extremes and influence remain included. Georgia Medicaid/foster certification and outside-program prekindergarten membership are broader population limits. Accelerated EOG/EOC coverage, nonlisted attribution completeness, valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Cobb County source release.

income_definition.label: Reported individual direct certification / school membership
income_definition.definition: 2024–25 reported CCD Final 2a individual Direct Certification Education Unit Total divided by that school’s own reported same-year Membership Education Unit Total, including pre-K where enrolled. Original Georgia notes say Medicaid income was added to SNAP/TANF certification starting in 2024 and foster records were received. Membership covers state-funded programs and includes prekindergarten pupils in outside programs. This benefit and status measure is an economic disadvantage proxy, not full household-income FRPL or universal/CEP meal receipt. Both counts require Reported flags; masks, missing or derived counts, other-year income and tested subgroup denominators never substitute. Reporting coverage and completeness are unknown.
